entities.name: PEX10 (C. elegans)
observations: Exact 314-aa query sequence match to reviewed UniProt C0HKD7; calculated mass 36.0 kDa and pI 9.01.
Pfam detects Pex2_Pex12 domain at residues 18–221 and RING-related zinc-finger signatures at residues 254–300.
Annotated as a peroxisomal membrane multi-pass protein and E3 ubiquitin ligase component of the PEX2–PEX10–PEX12 retrotranslocation channel.
In *C. elegans*, implicated in export and recycling of peroxisomal PEX5; ubiquitination can promote PEX5 degradation when recycling is compromised.

entities.name: PEX5
observations: Peroxisomal matrix-protein import receptor; PEX10-associated retrotranslocation returns PEX5 from peroxisomes to the cytosol for recycling.

entities.name: PEX2-PEX10-PEX12 channel
observations: Peroxisomal retrotranslocation channel mediating passage and recycling of the PEX5 receptor.
